record.file_problem: Repository metadata and README only; the listed report and code were not read.
record.tranche_reason: The README reports harmful-request refusal results for a model described as Heretic-abliterated, a weight-edit approach, but does not report the original activation-direction intervention.
record.gate_note: The README reports Stage-0 probe outcomes for the abliterated model. The listed Stage-1 pipeline and files are not evidence of Stage-1 results.
record.test_reason: The README applies Heretic abliteration as a pipeline tool and reports only deployment probe outcomes. It gives no unedited-model baseline, so it cannot show that the edit removed refusal. It also states the Stage-0 model has persona prompting and possibly other modifications, so the 0/10 count is not attributable to abliteration alone. It is not a test of V2.
record.authors_conclusion: Roughly right. The README reports 0/10 Indonesian harmful refusals and 0/5 fluent Indonesian tasks at Stage 0, and says Stage 1 is required. It also reports that generation depends on sampling settings. It draws no conclusion about refusal directions or the effect of abliteration.
record.recipe_differences: Tool/pipeline repository. It describes Heretic abliteration and a staged CPT/SFT pipeline, not the original difference-in-means activation ablation and addition procedure.
record.method_sensitivity: Reported generation-loop outcomes vary with repeat penalty and temperature.
record.problems: No unedited-model baseline or uncertainty estimates are reported. Stage-0 Indonesian task fluency is 0/5; the listed Stage-1 pipeline has no reported results in the README.
record.rows_left_out: No additional README results bearing on the claim were left out. The README's decode-speed and loaded-memory figures do not measure refusal removal or retained capability relevant to the claim.

untested.parts: No difference-in-means direction, ablation or addition is measured.
No unedited baseline, no description of the edit, and no attribution of the 0/10 refusals to the weight edit. Stage-1 results are not reported.

record.verdict_notes: This is a repository README only, and the report and code were not read. The record's 'supports' and 'limits_scope' labels for V2 are withdrawn because there is no baseline and no attribution to the edit. Counts are on tiny probe sets with no uncertainty.

versions.untested_parts: No difference-in-means direction is measured, projected out at every layer and position, or added.
No before-edit refusal rate or comparison to the unedited model is reported; only Stage-0 results are given, not Stage-1 results.
No jailbreak suppression mechanism or training against ablation is tested.
No comparison of a single direction with an affine, cone, or multi-direction account.
No separation of harmfulness judgments from refusal decisions.
No transfer test across languages, model variants, or training stages.
No test of how refusal training determines whether a removable direction exists.
